transformation.description: Mask every numerical token in the new disclosure, including table cells, duplicate guidance prose, actuals and year headings. A broad missing-numerical-disclosure control, not an isolated table-parser ablation.

config.selection: Reuse 72 byte-identical v2 synthetic heldout cases and two original supplemental natural withdrawal/rollover cases. B/C use unchanged v8 code; all inputs are exposed regression. No new blind-test claim. Retain frozen uncertain charges and block identical wire requests.

pricing.assumption: Peak rates, all input charged as cache miss; ignore all discounts.

spans.quote: •Fourth Quarter Revenue of $8.38 Billion, up 14% Year-Over-Year ("Y/Y"), up 17% Constant Currency ("CC")
•FY23 Revenue of $31.4 Billion, up 18% Y/Y, up 22% CC
•Full Year FY24 Revenue Guidance of $34.5 Billion to $34.7 Billion, up ~10% Y/Y

“For the full year we delivered $31.4 billion in revenue, up 18% year-over-year, or 22% in constant currency, one of the best performances of any enterprise software company our size,” said Marc Benioff Chair and CEO of Salesforce.
Revenue: Total fourth quarter revenue was $8.38 billion, an increase of 14% Y/Y, and 17% CC.
Total fiscal 2023 revenue was $31.35 billion, an increase of 18% Y/Y, and 22% CC.
As of March 1, 2023, the Company is initiating its first quarter GAAP and non-GAAP EPS guidance, current remaining performance obligation growth guidance, and revenue guidance.
The Company is initiating its full year FY24 revenue guidance, GAAP and non-GAAP EPS guidance, GAAP and non-GAAP operating margin guidance, and operating cash flow guidance.
